text:
kevin_procurement: Heads up — partial inbound for PO# PO-2049 delayed at FRA customs. Carrier shows a hold; vendor originally promised 3/24 ETA. We have 10 H100 units on that manifest, 6 cleared so far. Need RMA plan for 4 replacements and routing decision. AWB: `123-45678901`.

oliver_vendor: Sorry for the mess — carrier flagged an HS code mismatch on the invoice. Working with our broker to reclass. If reclass goes through ETA 48–72h; alternatively we can ship 4 replacement units overnight from our DE pool. Can route to your DE depot or AMS. We can cover uplift if you prefer replacements. :sorry:

kevin_procurement: If you can ship replacements from DE pool that's preferable. Please confirm you cover uplift and provide replacement AWBs + serials. Also need photos of units and tamper seals for the claim.

emma_logistics: DE depot (Frankfurt) has a 24h receiving window. If replacements land before 16:00 CET we can intake same day. Routing code for depot: `DE-FRA-RT03`. What carrier/ETD?

oliver_vendor: Proposed shipments: `AWB-REP-99887766` and `AWB-REP-99887767`, ETD tomorrow 06:00 CET with expedited courier. Serial ranges: S/N 8020–8023. I'll attach photos to this thread once I have them.

jia_infra: From infra side we should pre-drain the 4 affected nodes and mark them degraded. Please share the serial->node mapping so we can schedule reimage. If replacements arrive, priority goes to prod pool-1.

olivia_ops: Need capacity-impact note — losing 4 H100s drops Dedicated pool throughput ~18% for ~48h. Can we pull 2 spares from spare-pool for immediate needs? If vendor covers uplift, recommend accepting replacements and releasing spares back to general pool afterwards.

kevin_procurement: Agree — I'll request 2 spares to be pulled for now and create the RMA ticket.

rma-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-88902. Status: pending vendor confirmation. Assigned: emma_logistics, kevin_procurement.

oliver_vendor: :eyes: Confirm vendor covers courier uplift and any broker charges. Photos uploaded: https://drive.vendorco.com/ship-photos/PO-2049 (link). Will update with final AWBs when manifested.

kevin_procurement: Please confirm final AWBs and expected customs docs (commercial invoice with HS 8471). Also include vendor POC for broker if customs requests details.

oliver_vendor: Confirmed — final AWBs `AWB-REP-99887766`, `AWB-REP-99887767`. Commercial invoice will include HS 8471. Vendor broker: Marco R. <marco@vendorco.com>. We will cover courier + broker fees up to €2,500 total. ETA to DE depot 2024-03-22 10:00 CET.

emma_logistics: Noted. Reserving intake slot for 10:00 CET. Please send ASN to `fwd-depot@redwood.com`. Depot requires pallet labels 1–4 and full serial manifest prior to arrival.

jia_infra: Once ASN and serials arrive I'll schedule node drains starting 11:00 CET and prepare reimage playbook. Keep me posted if ETA slips.

kevin_procurement: Thanks — cc me and olivia on the ASN. If vendor cannot cover full uplift, we need an invoice estimate before ship; otherwise proceed.

oliver_vendor: Copy — cc'd on ASN. If anything changes I'll update this thread by EOD. Apologies for the disruption.

kevin_procurement: Appreciate it. We'll hold 2 spares for 24h then release back if replacements arrive. :thumbsup:

rma-bot: RMA-88902 updated: vendor confirmed replacements. Next action: vendor to send final AWB & ASN.
